```{r}
Gradient_COI <- All_COI_data %>% 
  filter(Project_name == "Gradient") %>%
  index_RA(Library_ID, Species, Abundance, Sample_date, Site_ID, Line_out_depth)

Gradient_COI %>% 
  pull(Site_ID) %>% unique()



Gradient_COI %>% 
  #group_by(Library_ID, Sample_date, Site_ID, Line_out_depth) %>% 
  #summarise() %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_raster(aes(Site_ID, -as.numeric(Line_out_depth),
                 fill = RA_Index)) +
  facet_wrap("Species") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(high = '#4daf4a',
                       low = "white") +
  theme_minimal_vgrid(font_size = 8) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#F5F5F5', colour = 'darkgrey'))



```
